business_problem: Since 2020, Fujitsu Limited (Fujitsu) has been promoting Fujitsu Transformation (Fujitra), a company-wide digital transformation project. As a part of this program, the company built a data utilization platform (OneData) on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
solution_summary: Since 2020, Fujitsu Limited (Fujitsu) has been promoting Fujitsu Transformation (Fujitra), a company-wide digital transformation project. As a part of this program, the company built a data utilization platform (OneData) on Amazon Web Services (AWS). Fujitsu selected AWS to build its data use solution. In its comparison of major cloud services, it focused on AWS Lake Formation for its orchestration functions. “We focused on data security. No other company offered a service like AWS Lake Formation with access control authority management and monitoring functions, which was the deciding factor in our selection,” says Doi.

solution_components.name: Amazon SageMaker Studio
solution_components.role: Gives data scientists a managed environment for experimentation and model development.

solution_components.name: Amazon SageMaker
solution_components.role: Supports model training, tuning, deployment, or managed ML inference.

solution_components.name: Amazon Aurora
solution_components.role: Stores transactional data with higher throughput and availability.

solution_components.name: AWS Glue
solution_components.role: Prepares and moves data between operational sources and analytics or ML environments.

solution_components.name: Amazon Redshift
solution_components.role: Serves as the analytics warehouse for curated business data.

solution_components.name: AWS Lake Formation
solution_components.role: Governs access control and orchestration for the enterprise data lake.

data_flow: Data flows from AWS Glue into Amazon Aurora, Amazon Redshift, is processed by Amazon SageMaker Studio, Amazon SageMaker.
business_outcome: As of May 2023, the number of departments using the data utilization platform has increased to approximately 140, and the number of users has reached approximately 27,000. The number of data linkage systems has expanded significantly to around 40, the number of dashboards to around 250, and the number of data catalogs to around 250.
architecture_clues: OneData was launched in April 2022 and is used by the four global regions to achieve data-driven management.
The architecture is based on serverless and managed services and consists primarily of AWS for data collection, processing, analytics, orchestration, data lake, and consumption too
